_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/players/test_replace_lose_game.py. `t_golden_throne` is The Golden Throne's Arcane Life-support line as printed, without the mana ability the test does not need and not legendary, so two of them can show the second replacing the next loss; `t_platinum_holder` is a plain 'you can't lose the game' static, so the test can show the prohibition is asked before the replacement.
